datafield.subfield: Silver Buckle Press, University of Wisconsin-Madison Libraries,
Project organized by the Silver Buckle Press under the direction of the printer and curator Tracy Honn.
Contains 31 leaves (28 x 19 cm.) printed and signed by different printers from various presses laid in a clamshell box.
Limited ed. of 100 signed and numbered copies.

Heads: Land Marks Press / Lynne Avadenka -- Flying Fish Press / Julie Chen -- The Wing & the Wheel Press / Terry Chouinard -- Street of Crocodiles Press / Jules Remedios Faye -- Stone Monkey Press / Gayle Hayes Hachen -- Arcadian Press / Caren Heft -- Ram's Horn Press / Mary Kennedy -- Blue Heron Press / Karen Kunc -- Kate Leonard -- The Nomadic Press / Dan Mayer -- Pressious Jade / Katherine Ng -- The Windowpane Press / Bonnie Thompson Norman -- Robin Price -- The Weaselsleeves press / Janet Rodney -- Hand-in-Glove-Press / Val Simonetti -- Grey Spider Press / Chris Stern.
